{{Quote|Vinefish fresh off the grill.|The vendor, to Zeerid Korr|<ref name="Deceived" />}}
A '''vendor''' sold [[vinefish]] near [[Yinta Lake]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Vulta]]. The vendor attempted to sell some the freshly grilled vinefish to [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Zeerid Korr]]<ref name="Deceived" /> in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3653 BBY]].<ref name="TEA">According to ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', the end of the [[Great Galactic War]], which was concurrent with Zeerid Korr's visit to Vulta, occurred in [[3653 BBY]].</ref> Korr was on his way to meet with his [[Gender/Legends|daughter]], [[Arra Yooms]], when the vendor called out to Korr. Korr did not buy any of the vinefish, however, and continued on his way.<ref name="Deceived" />

==Behind the scenes==
The vendor first appeared in the novel ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]'', written by [[Paul S. Kemp]] and published in [[2011]].<ref name="Deceived" />
